name: japan-eu-parcel
description: Free checker for sending parcels from Japan to the EU by Japan Post after the 2026 EU rules: per-country routes (IOSS DDP / DAP / no IOSS), Germany B2C ban from 2026-11-09, €3 duty + €2 handling fee per item, PID, gift limits. Keyless JSON API + MCP.
